rules.title: Security deposit cap (Assembly Bill 12)
rules.requirement: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent as a security deposit for unfurnished and furnished units. Last month's rent is considered part of the security deposit; first month's rent is not.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords of unfurnished and furnished units, other than qualifying small landlords.

rules.exemptions: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total, where ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons, can charge up to two months' rent.

rules.title: Small landlord security deposit allowance (Assembly Bill 12)
rules.requirement: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons.

rules.title: Move-in photographs of unit
rules.requirement: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy to document its condition.
rules.coverage_text: New tenancies beginning on or after July 1, 2025.
rules.citation: California state law (summarized on Berkeley Rent Board Security Deposits page)
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy to document the condition of the unit.
rules.effective_date_phrase: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025

rules.title: Move-out walk-through inspection
rules.requirement: Landlords must offer a walk-through inspection during the last two weeks of a tenancy to identify items needing repair or cleaning, so tenants can correct issues and avoid deposit deductions.
rules.citation: California state law (summarized on Berkeley Rent Board Security Deposits page)
rules.quoted_span: Under state law, landlords must offer a walk-through inspection during the last two weeks of a tenancy to identify any items that need repair/cleaning.

rules.title: Limits on security deposit deductions
rules.requirement: A landlord may deduct only amounts reasonably necessary to cover rent default, repair tenant-caused damage beyond normal wear and tear, clean the unit to its move-in level of cleanliness, and, if allowed by the lease, restore or replace personal property or furniture. The landlord cannot charge for professional carpet or other professional cleaning unless reasonably necessary to return the premises to move-in condition, minus ordinary wear and tear.
rules.citation: California state law (summarized on Berkeley Rent Board Security Deposits page)
rules.quoted_span: A landlord may deduct only the amount that is reasonably necessary to:

rules.title: Return of security deposit and itemized statement
rules.requirement: All or any remaining portion of a security deposit must be returned within 21 days after the tenant leaves the unit vacant, with a written itemized statement of deductions and supporting documents. Starting January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that necessary repairs were completed.
rules.citation: California state law (summarized on Berkeley Rent Board Security Deposits page)
rules.quoted_span: If deductions were made, the landlord must give the tenant a written statement itemizing the amount of and and purpose for any security deposit deductions, accompanied by copies of documents showing charges incurred and deducted by the landlord to repair or clean the premises, including a copy of any bill, invoice, or receipt for materials or supplies deductions.

rules.title: Move-out photographs before deductions
rules.requirement: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must photograph a unit after regaining possession but before any repairs or cleaning for which they intend to deduct from the deposit, and give the photos and a written cost explanation to the tenant with the itemized statement.
rules.citation: California state law (summarized on Berkeley Rent Board Security Deposits page)
rules.quoted_span: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession, but before any repairs or cleaning for which the landlord intends to make a deduction from the security deposit.

rules.title: Security deposit interest (Berkeley Rent Ordinance)
rules.requirement: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year, and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
rules.coverage_text: Tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
